Since to be loved endures

 
S
INCE
 to be loved endures,

  To love is wise:

Earth hath no good but yours,

  Brave, joyful eyes:

 

Earth hath no sin but thine,
        5

  Dull eye of scorn:

O’er thee the sun doth pine,

  And angels mourn.
